description: Dig one name and type at one board resolver, or at Cloudflare, Google, Quad9 and AdGuard side by side (resolver all): records, flags, rcode, EDE, latency. For a whole domain use check_domain, for the delegation trace, for the zone's own servers sweep_domain. Asked over DoH from the isitdns edge, with no key and a limit of 100 calls a minute per address. from moves the question to that region's probe as Do53 over UDP, and follow: true adds the CNAME chain as separate reads with DNSSEC off. A resolver given as an address must be on the board.

cd.description: Ask the resolver not to validate

dnssec.description: Set the DO bit and read AD

follow.description: Also walk the CNAME chain from this name, hop by hop, to its addresses

from.description: Ask from the probe in this region

name.description: The name, e.g. _dmarc.example.com. Also as "domain"; a URL is read as its host.

resolver.description: A board resolver id (cloudflare, google, quad9, opendns, adguard, cleanbrowsing, controld, quad9-unfiltered, adguard-family, cleanbrowsing-family, adguard-unfiltered, opendns-familyshield, nextdns, cloudflare-malware, cloudflare-family, mullvad-base, dns4eu-protective), an alias such as 8.8.8.8, or all for cloudflare, google, quad9, adguard side by side.

type.description: Record type, e.g. A, MX, TXT, DS, HTTPS, or TYPE<n>

name: dig

agreement.description: resolver all: rows grouped by answer, and the ones with none

api.description: The /api GET that asks it again, as a new reading

askAgain.description: The isitdns.net page that asks it again, when one does

follow.description: follow: the CNAME hops, how the chain ends, its reads

query.description: The question as asked: name, type, flags, transport

receipts.description: One per DNS read: what, of whom, from where, when, rcode, flags, EDE, ms, answer

results.description: One row per resolver: id, response (rcode, flags, records, EDE), latencyMs, at, vantage, or error

title: Dig one record
